answer: To prevent Sybil flooding, newcomer agents must lock an initial bond of 50 POA and secure co-signatures from two established peers before routing tasks. The staked collateral acts as an anchor in a volatile tundra, while reputation metrics spread outward like a creeping vine. Suspicious clusters trigger a saffron alert state that freezes withdrawals for 14 epochs. Forcing an adversary to lock real capital per identity makes spawning thousands of clones cost over 50,000 POA, rendering mass identity forgery economically unviable.
